# Ruin › Ruin Location

> When learning about a distant ruin, use this table to reveal its location. If you come upon a ruin in your travels, pick a location as appropriate to your surroundings.
>
> Datasworn `oracle_rollable:sundered_isles/ruin/location` · 1d100
